06-18-1901 is June 18, 1901.  
40 weeks = 280 days.  
280 days + 6 days = 286 days before June 18, 1901.  

Count back:  
June 18 → May 31 is 18 days back (286 - 18 = 268 left).  
May has 31 days, so April 30 is 31 more days back (268 - 31 = 237 left).  
Continue subtracting full months:  
March 31 (237 - 31 = 206),  
February 28 (206 - 28 = 178),  
January 31 (178 - 31 = 147),  
December 1900 has 31 days (147 - 31 = 116),  
November 30 (116 - 30 = 86),  
October 31 (86 - 31 = 55),  
September 30 (55 - 30 = 25),  
August 31 (25 - 31 → negative, so stop at August).  

25 days before August 31, 1900 = August 6, 1900.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1900-08-06
